verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document user-defined event-triggered automation rules in Pigment. Scheduled imports are a recurring schedule, not an event trigger. Tagging HR to send a notification is a manual one-off action. The Analyst Agent's continuous monitoring is not a user-configurable rule-to-action mechanism. Planning platforms could plausibly ship workflow automation, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
